messages:
maria-g: Postmortem follow-up: KV cache eviction + autoscaler flapping. Need a concise runbook update: triage checklist, quick mitigations, escalation order, and automation owners. Volunteers?

kevin: I can draft the triage checklist and minimal CLI commands. will share by EOD.

lee: i'll take escalation order + fallback play (who pages, who approves routing), include exact step to flip 10% traffic to small-pool.

sara: i'll own alert thresholds and add a staging smoke test for the alert. propose alert when kv_hit_ratio drops > 10% over 30m AND p50 latency +200ms.

oncall-bot: Task created: runbook-update_kv_eviction assigned to kevin, lee, sara. due: 2026-05-15.

kevin: triage snippet (WIP):
`kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=runtime`
`curl -s http://runtime-mgr:9100/metrics | grep kv_cache`
`kubectl get events -n inference --field-selector involvedObject.kind=HorizontalPodAutoscaler | tail -n 30`
`if cache miss spike -> kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime-mgr -n inference`

lee: escalation draft: If P95 > 1000ms OR errors > 3% for 10m -> page @sre-oncall -> collect logs + last 50 autoscaler events -> if no ack in 8m -> page infra-lead -> approved -> run model-fallback (route 10% small-pool) -> validate.

sara: automation notes: auto-cache-priming script = kevin. auto-scale override = manual for Dedicated, staged for Hosted. will add CI job in staging to run weekly.

maria-g: please add decision table: hosted vs dedicated approvers, and a QA checklist before merge (non-destructive smoke, staging alert firing, fallback dry-run). we'll review in incidents sync.

oncall-bot: Follow-up recorded: [runbook draft, alert patch, fallback play]. Owners: kevin, lee, sara. Next check-in: 2026-05-12.
